build.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo +1.87.0 test --locked -p chat_cli --bin chat_cli codeplane_native_capture --no-run

execution.network: unshare --net with an empty process environment and no configured network interfaces
execution.database: native rusqlite in-memory SQLite under cfg(test)
execution.filesystem: native Fs::Chroot temporary filesystem under cfg(test)
execution.model_source: Os.client.set_mock_output with two harmless text responses
execution.retrieval: get_conversation_by_path verified against exact raw conversations.value row after ChatSession.spawn

limitations: Native ChatSession and SQLite writer with upstream inert model/input facilities, not a vendor conversation
The test-only overlay adds capture/assertions and a raw read accessor, not replacement producer or storage logic
